training.schedule: Original 30-epoch 10% warmup/cosine prefix, then constant terminal LR0.0001 through epoch200
training.head: Unchanged GainFusionHead hidden128, GELU, dropout0.1; LayerNorm(moment)/sqrt1024 and training-only standardized raw statistics/sqrt15; zero excluded branch
training.input_gain: sqrt(1039/active_branches); one for statistics/moment, two for fusion; no sweep
training.selection: Best validation Macro-F1 within200 epochs, earliest exact tie; also report epoch200 endpoint
training.cache: Extract unadapted AMP features only for selected9827 training rows and3510 validation rows; no supervised encoder training or test features

matched_statistics_control.reference: Unadapted FP32 MOMENT cache; each CV-training fold fits its own reference BranchScaler, identical to E01C. No supervised encoder leakage.

success_rules.strongest_reference: Per-seed max(new statistics NN, new moment NN, parent stats RF, parent stats SVM, matched statistics SVM, parent frozen fusion SVM)
success_rules.endpoint_rule: Descriptive only; do not substitute endpoint for predeclared best-within-budget primary
success_rules.ci95: Descriptive paired t interval, not a significance gate or independent-population guarantee

limitations: Same dataset and overlapping random splits, not external confirmation. Seed42 was previously used in E01 discovery; all four seeds' older SVM validation results are known, but new gain-head outcomes are not inspected before this freeze. Seed43 alone selected this readout and is excluded from replication rules. More epoch-level validation choices than old SVM protocols; budgets disclosed, not claimed equal. Training labels9827 plus validation labels3510 per split. The earlier E03P failure and E03D-v1 numerical incident remain unchanged.
